method.selection_policy: Only market-relevant items with interpretable direction are included. Low-signal central-bank admin notices, stale/duplicate stories, pure single-stock noise and asset-class leaks are excluded.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; mega-cap/AI/earnings allowed only when market-moving.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures price framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive, supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket: EURUSD/GBPUSD/AUDUSD/CADUSD/JPYUSD strength positive; DXY/USD strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework: yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.
